latest.title: Risk scores sort survival odds in paediatric OHCA
latest.finding: 27.8% survived to admission and 11.9% to discharge; scores using gender, arrest location, witness status, aetiology, bystander CPR, prehospital AED use and first rhythm reached AUROC 0.76–0.82, with average survival 3–48% across low/moderate/high groups

latest.title: Whole blood in paediatric trauma: early program data
latest.finding: Trauma caused 96% of paediatric transfusions (74% gunshot, 84% all penetrating); 45% had elevated age-adjusted SIPA, 20% were pulseless; survival 50%, died 39%, unknown 11%; younger children showed the largest drop in shock index after resuscitation

latest.title: Out-of-hospital RSI practice across South African services
latest.finding: Trauma caused 238/354 (67.2%) of RSIs; ketamine documented in 74.9%, rocuronium in 52.3%, pre-oxygenation in 99.4%, end-tidal CO2 monitoring in 83.6% and post-intubation sedation/analgesia in 72%

latest.title: How common are blood-borne infections in first responders
latest.finding: Pooled prevalence: hepatitis B 6.2% (95% CI 4.5–8.2), hepatitis C 1.8% (0.9–2.9), MRSA colonisation ~4% (2.6–5.9), COVID-19 among unvaccinated staff 13.6% (4.8–25.9), falling to 7.3% after excluding high-bias studies
